item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
A Heat Advisory through Sunday evening and a slate of local government meetings on August 11 are the most immediate matters for Benton County residents.
Heat Advisory in effect until Sunday evening. The National Weather Service has issued a Heat Advisory for Benton County with heat index values up to 108 expected from noon to 8 PM CDT Sunday.
Bentonville Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council meets August 11. The council is set to consider several zoning changes, a property vacation, and two grants at this meeting. Agendas for the other meetings this period are published too.
Taziki’s opens Rogers location. Taziki’s Mediterranean Café opened a new location at 1771 W. Pleasant Grove Road, Suite 104 in Rogers, with about 2,900 square feet and seating for 85.
Simmons Foods promotes executives, creates chief commercial officer role. Simmons Foods promoted Scott Salmon to chief commercial officer and named Jacob Rogers as his successor in Siloam Springs.
Walton Family Foundation awards $599,139 grant to NWACC. The Walton Family Foundation gave a $599,139 grant to NorthWest Arkansas Community College to expand its LIFE program.
Benton County holds intergovernmental meeting over One-Cent sales tax. Benton County officials discussed the one-cent sales tax at a meeting on August 7.
Fayetteville confirms cooling center locations through August 16. The City of Fayetteville has confirmed cooling shelters for the week of August 8 through 16 to help residents during the heat.
Multiple departments coordinate response to Northwest Arkansas shop fire. Multiple regional first responders worked together to extinguish a large shop building fire on Saturday afternoon.
Downtown Springdale Alliance hosts free picnic in the park series. The Downtown Springdale Alliance is hosting a free Picnic in the Park series throughout August on Saturdays.
